_doc: Per-card capture settings for atlas/tools/screens.py. shot_url: the operator's public human page when the card's own URL is not one (raw JSON/markdown, wallet wall); it is recorded as shot_url in the manifest. wait: extra ms before the shot. keys: keys pressed after load (splash gates). click_text: exact button texts to click (welcome/consent modals). gl: software WebGL for canvas/3D pages.
